title: Head of Logistics
about: As Head of Logistics you will own all operational planning for the team — from workshop management to getting the car and people to competition. You will coordinate across departments to keep build timelines on track and ensure the team is always ready to perform.
tasks: Plan and execute transport of the car, equipment and team to competition events
Manage workshop scheduling, tool inventory and consumables
Coordinate travel, accommodation and travel budgets for the full team
Maintain team documentation, meeting structures and internal communication
Support the team lead with planning and cross-departmental coordination
achieve: A smooth, well-organised competition campaign from build to podium
Tangible project management experience in a fast-moving technical team
A reputation as the person who makes everything possible

title: Logistics & Operations Coordinator
about: As Logistics & Operations Coordinator you will keep the machinery around the car running — the workshop, the equipment, the travel and the plans that get a full race team to the start line. You will work closely with the Head of Logistics and every department to remove friction so the engineers can build.
tasks: Coordinate workshop logistics — tools, materials, consumables and ordering
Help plan and execute transport of the car, equipment and team to events
Organise travel, accommodation and practical arrangements for team activities
Keep inventory, packing lists and operational documentation up to date
Support cross-departmental planning and day-to-day team operations
achieve: A competition campaign that runs on rails because of your planning
Practical project coordination experience in a technical organisation
Insight into everything it takes to field a race team — beyond the car itself

title: Head of Electrical
about: As Head of Electrical you will lead the electrical sub-team responsible for the car's entire electrical system — from high voltage accumulator and power electronics to low voltage control and sensing. You will define the architecture, guide the team technically and ensure all systems meet FSAE safety and performance standards.
tasks: Define and own the electrical architecture across HV and LV systems
Lead design reviews and sign off on PCB layouts, wiring harnesses and BMS design
Ensure compliance with FSAE EV rules and coordinate with scrutineers
Mentor team members in circuit design, embedded systems and safe HV practices
Manage integration between electrical systems and the software and mechanical teams
achieve: A fully certified, competition-legal electrical system on the car
Leadership experience guiding a multi-person engineering sub-team
Deep expertise in EV powertrain design and automotive electronics

title: Head of Business
about: As Head of Business you will lead the business and marketing department, overseeing sponsorship, communications, content and economics. You will be the external face of Helix for sponsors and partners, and work closely with the team lead to ensure the organisation runs professionally and sustainably.
tasks: Lead and coordinate the business department across sponsorship, marketing and economics
Own sponsor relationships and ensure all partner commitments are delivered
Set the communications strategy across social media, website and press
Report on financial and commercial performance to the board and team lead
Represent Helix at industry events and build the team's professional reputation
achieve: A fully funded season with a strong, active sponsor portfolio
Leadership experience running a multi-function business team
A professional network spanning Norwegian engineering, tech and industry

title: Mechanical Engineer
about: As a Mechanical Engineer on the Helix team you will design, analyse and manufacture the physical components that make up the car — from chassis and suspension to drivetrain and aerodynamics. You will take parts from concept to CAD to a finished component on a competition vehicle, learning practical engineering skills no lecture can teach.
tasks: Design components and assemblies in CAD as part of a sub-system group
Run FEM analyses and simulations to validate designs against load cases
Manufacture parts hands-on through machining, composites work and 3D printing
Test, iterate and document your components through the build season
Collaborate with the electrical and software teams on system integration
achieve: Parts you designed and built driving on a real race car at competition
Hands-on manufacturing experience with metals, composites and rapid prototyping
A complete design-to-production engineering cycle on your CV

title: Electrical Engineer
about: As an Electrical Engineer on the Helix team you will design and build the systems that power and control the car — PCBs, wiring harnesses, sensors and battery systems. You will work across low voltage and high voltage under experienced guidance, and see your hardware come alive on a competition EV.
tasks: Design, assemble and test PCBs for control, sensing and power distribution
Build and route wiring harnesses to automotive and FSAE standards
Integrate sensors and validate signals together with the software team
Contribute to accumulator and BMS work under HV safety supervision
Document designs and participate in reviews with the electrical sub-team
achieve: Your own hardware running on a competition electric race car
Practical electronics experience from schematic to soldered, tested board
Working knowledge of EV architecture and high voltage safety practice

title: Software Engineer
about: As a Software Engineer on the Helix team you will build and maintain the software systems that make the car move autonomously and intelligently. You will work across the full stack — from low-level control and sensor integration to high-level planning and simulation — in a collaborative, fast-moving engineering environment.
tasks: Develop and maintain software modules within the ROS 2 autonomous driving stack
Implement algorithms for perception, path planning or vehicle control
Write clean, testable C++ or Python code in a collaborative codebase
Integrate and validate software on the physical car and in simulation
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation
achieve: Production code running on a real autonomous vehicle at competition
Hands-on experience with ROS 2, embedded systems and real-time software
A strong foundation in robotics and autonomous systems development

title: Partner Relations Coordinator
about: You will be responsible for securing the financial foundation of the team — identifying prospects, building relationships and closing sponsorship agreements that fund our season. This is a sales and relationship-driven role that combines strategic thinking with persistence and strong communication skills.
tasks: Research, identify and approach potential sponsors across industries
Prepare tailored proposals, pitch decks and partnership packages
Lead meetings and negotiations with companies at various levels
Manage the pipeline of prospects and maintain accurate records of outreach
Work with the Head of Business to ensure sponsor deliverables are met
achieve: A secured sponsor portfolio that meaningfully funds the season
Real experience in B2B sales, negotiation and account management
Lasting professional relationships in the Norwegian engineering and tech industry

title: Finance Coordinator
about: As Finance Coordinator you will keep the team's economy healthy and transparent — budgets, accounting and the financial planning that turns sponsorship into a season. You will work closely with the Head of Business and department leads to make sure every krone is tracked and well spent.
tasks: Maintain the team budget and track spending across departments
Handle invoicing, reimbursements and day-to-day bookkeeping
Prepare financial reports for the board, team lead and sponsors
Support funding applications and manage payment follow-up with partners
Help department leads plan purchases within their budgets
achieve: Hands-on experience running the finances of a real organisation
Practical skills in budgeting, accounting and financial reporting
A key role in making an entire competition season financially possible

title: Communication & Content Manager
about: As Communication & Content Manager you will own how Helix tells its story — planning and running our communication across social media, the website and press. You will set the content strategy, keep the publishing rhythm going through the season and make sure sponsors, students and the FSAE community see what we're building.
tasks: Own the content calendar and publishing across our social channels
Set the tone and visual direction together with the design profile
Coordinate content creators and photographers around builds and events
Produce sponsor visibility content and ensure partner commitments are delivered
Track engagement and use it to sharpen the communication strategy
achieve: A visible, growing brand you shaped and ran through a full season
Real experience in communication strategy, publishing and analytics
A portfolio of campaigns tied to a race car people care about

title: Content Creator
about: As a Content Creator you will capture the build, the people and the competition — photo, video and graphics that bring the Helix story to life. Workshop nights, track days and everything in between become your raw material, with creative freedom to shape how it's told.
tasks: Shoot photo and video in the workshop, at events and at competition
Edit short-form video and reels for social media
Create graphics for announcements, sponsor features and recruitment
Build and maintain the team's shared media library
Work with the Communication & Content Manager on campaigns and deadlines
achieve: A published portfolio of real work seen by thousands
Hands-on experience in media production from capture to post
Front-row access to every milestone of a competition season

title: Open Application
about: Don't see a role that fits you exactly? We're always interested in hearing from talented, motivated students who share our passion for engineering and innovation. Tell us who you are, what you bring to the table and how you think you can contribute to Helix NMBU.
tasks: Tell us about yourself and your background
Describe the skills and experience you'd bring to the team
Let us know which area of the car or organisation interests you most
Share examples of projects, coursework or work you're proud of
achieve: A place on a passionate, high-performing student team
Hands-on experience in your area of interest
A network spanning engineering, business and design at NMBU and beyond
